title: Staggered probe-driven rollback horizon with traffic holdpoints
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: recurrent flapping during canary ramps with delayed downstream metrics produced noisy rollback triggers. This PR introduces traffic holdpoints a stepwise traffic gating primitive that pauses traffic increases at configurable checkpoints until a set of probe checks pass and a rollback horizon window is evaluated. The approach reduces false positive rollbacks by requiring staggered probes across cohorts and calculating a rollback horizon that ensures we only consider signals within the latest contiguous evaluation window. High level changes: implement holdpoint primitives in the orchestrator, add rollback horizon calculator with timebound heuristics, integrate probe sequencer to run staggered health checks per cohort, expose new RolloutPolicy fields in the API, add e2e and unit tests, and docs and example. Checklist: - design doc and diagrams added to docs/rollouts/traffic_holdpoints.md, - implementation of holdpoints and horizon logic, - unit tests for boundary conditions and TTL expiry, - e2e test exercising a failing cohort and observing safe pause and rollback decision, - docs and SDK example updated, - CI pipeline adjusted for longer e2e timeout. Commits: add holdpoint primitive and basic sequencer; add rollback horizon implementation and unit tests; wire holdpoints into orchestrator with policy parsing; add e2e test harness for staggered probes; docs and example; CI: increase timeout for e2e. Changed areas and rationale: serving/controller/orchestrator.go now includes a holdpoint state machine that records holdpoint id, cohort mapping, and probe outcomes. serving/safety/rollback_horizon.go computes earliest safe rollback window given probe timestamps, request latencies, and metric ingestion delay estimates. api/v1/rollout_types.go introduces RolloutPolicy fields holdpoints and rollbackHorizon with TTLs and probe sequences. k8s manifest updates add CRD schema validation. e2e/rollout_holdpoints_test.go simulates a noisy metric emitter to validate the safety gate behavior. Observability: new rollout metrics rollout_holdpoint_pause_seconds and rollout_rollback_horizon_violation_count and traces instrumented for holdpoint transitions. Review conversation summary: Ian Park: called out race between KV cache warming and probe timing could still cause spurious rollbacks, asked for stronger cache warm join. Author reply: adjusted sequencer to delay probe start until kv cache warm flag present or fallback to warm windows, added unit tests. Leila Gomez: requested clearer telemetry for holdpoint ingress latency and suggested reducing default stagger spacing, author updated metrics and made default stagger conservative while exposing tuning fields. Ravi Patel: suggested adding a manual holdpoint override in Console for emergency pause, author implemented a simple override API and Console toggle in a follow-up commit. CI and validation: pipeline rollout-e2e ran with a single flaky test failure on first run, rerun passed; full CI passed including unit, lint, typecheck, integration, and e2e. Security review: no secrets or new surface area beyond existing rollout APIs, added schema validations for policy fields. Merge outcome: merged to main via squash merge after two approvals. Release notes: add new RolloutPolicy holdpoints and rollback horizon feature, default behavior is opt-in via policy; includes observability metrics and Console manual override; recommended tuning steps added to docs. Backwards compatibility: new fields are optional, existing rollouts unchanged. Follow-ups: track ENG-1976 to add automated policy recommendations based on traffic shape, and ENG-1842 to run broader canary validation across multi-region traffic. Notes for operators: default TTLs and stagger values are conservative; increase staging exposure before enabling for production; use Console holdpoint override for emergency pauses.
